dvids.title: Daily Operations Aboard USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77)
dvids.desc: A video showing logistics specialist U.S. Sailors aboard Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77). George H.W. Bush is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations to support maritime security and stability in the Middle East. (U.S. Navy Video)
